theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+1.32%) and Consumer Discretionary (+1.12%) led the market today, while Materials (-3.02%) and Real Estate (-0.77%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.69% versus -0.60% for defensives and -0.62% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.70%, Dow +0.53%, Nasdaq +1.00% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.50%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 6.38% to 15.99, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.83% to $4,098.60, crude oil was little changed at $86.80, and bitcoin slipped 0.08% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
